@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware.aix import AIXHardware
+
+
+def test_aix_cpu_facts_use_available_devices_as_cores(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'proc0 Available 00-00 Processor\nproc1 Available 00-01 Processor\n'
+            'proc2 Defined 00-02 Processor\n', ''),
+        (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+        (0, 'smt_threads 4 SMT threads False\n', ''),
+    ]
+
+    assert AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts() == {
+        'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 2,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 4,
+        'processor_vcpus': 8,
+    }
+
+
+def test_aix_cpu_facts_default_to_one_thread_per_core(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'proc0 Available 00-00 Processor\n', ''),
+        (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+        (1, '', 'attribute unavailable'),
+    ]
+
+    assert AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts() == {
+        'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 1,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 1,
+        'processor_vcpus': 1,
+    }
